slug: 2025-12-15 South Africa plans Intelligent Population Register in proposed civil registration reform

ZAF.note: Digital birth and death registration is only proposed in a draft white paper; no system procured, piloted or in service is stated.

facts.fact: South Africa's Home Affairs draft revised White Paper, open for input 12 December 2025 to 31 January 2026, proposes a digitally enabled Intelligent Population Register to modernise the National Population Register (Biometric Update).
